verdict.rationale: Docs show natural-language search queries and MCP-exposed tools that let agents decide when to save/retrieve memories in natural language, plus a CLI for terminal control — but the CLI itself is structured (add/search/list/update/delete) rather than free-form NL, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming robust natural-language command handling. missing for 10: independent corroboration of NL query accuracy, evidence that CLI/API supports free-form conversational commands beyond fixed operations.
